prompt: You keep putting off an assignment because the instructions feel unclear. Which step tackles the real cause of the delay?

options.text: Wait until the night before the deadline, when the pressure will force clarity
List what you do not understand and ask the teacher two specific questions before you start
Start writing at random and hope the meaning emerges, without ever checking
Copy the structure of a classmate's assignment

explanation: If confusion is what is stopping you, more pressure will not fix it. Naming the exact unknowns and asking specific questions removes the blockage so starting becomes straightforward.
